solutions.title: Recursive branching
solutions.strategy: Count ways by recursively choosing one-step and two-step moves.

timeComplexity.explanation: The recursion recomputes many smaller stair counts through two branches.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The deepest recursive call stack has one frame per remaining step.

solutions.title: Iterative two-state DP
solutions.strategy: Build the Fibonacci-style recurrence while keeping only the last two values.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each stair count from 3 through n is computed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the previous two counts and the current count are stored.
